title: not connecting
symptom: After changing the algorithm to the oopalgorithm, the connection between the miao miao and xdrip+ was lost. The app sees the miao miao but is stuck on the 'collecting initial data' screen and not getting any data.
cause: The user had other Libre related apps on the phone (like Libre Alarm) that interfered with the connection.
fix: Delete other Libre related apps and restart the phone.
evidence_quote: I think the problem was that I had other libre related apps on my phone that I forgot about (like libre alarm). I deleted the apps and restarted the phone and now it's connected again.
